text:
Zara: Quick sync 9: draft for 'Cohort Acceptance Flow' and the feedback-to-roadmap mapping. Goal: reliably onboard 4 partners in 8 weeks with measurable signal velocity.
Owen: Love the goal. What's the incentive structure? Keep it lean.
Zara: Three bands: Scout = early access + docs; Builder = $2.5k credits + 4 office hours; Integrator = $10k credits + 15h SRE + priority triage slot. Integrator requires a 5-week stability commit and a short anonymized case study.
Nadia: For VPC/on-prem Integrators add a one-time ops stipend $4k and require a runbook sign-off. Also require KMS checkbox on intake.
Kurt: Intake should capture data_class (NONE/PII/PHI), reproducible (y/n), severity (1-5), business_impact (low/med/high), and a short reproduction snippet. dp-bot should create a triage card plus optional GH issue.
dp-bot: Intake form posted: https://internal.redwood/dp/cohort-accept (auto-tag dp/cohort) :white_check_mark:
Zara: Prioritization formula (explainable and fast):
```
base = 3 if reproducible == "yes" else 0
impact = 2 if business_impact == "high" else 1 if business_impact == "med" else 0
severity_bonus = 1 if severity >=4 else 0
tier_mul = 1.25 if tier == "Integrator" else 1.1 if tier == "Builder" else 1.0
priority_score = (base + impact + severity_bonus) * tier_mul
```
Map: >=7 -> P0 (eng oncall + 48h SLA), 5-6 -> P1 (PM + eng sync 5bd), <=4 -> backlog/watch.
Owen: One tweak: add a velocity factor = number_of_reports_last_14d / 14. If velocity >=0.5, bump to next priority band. Helps surface noisy-but-frequent issues.
Nadia: Success criteria to remain active: by day 30 either >=8 valid calls/day OR automated daily evals running with quality drift <=3% for 7 days. If not met, offer downgrade or exit.
Kurt: Launch gates: staging SLOs stable 72h, no partner-specific quality regression >1.5% vs baseline, partner E2E tests green. Failure -> 72h hotfix window + rollback plan.
Zara: Action items: @Owen - confirm finance numbers; @Nadia - add KMS/runbook template; @Kurt - wire dp-bot export to GH + velocity metric; @Zara - finalize T&Cs and publish intake. Reconvene Thu morning.
Owen: I'll loop in finance, target numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Nadia: KMS checkbox + runbook draft tonight.
Kurt: I'll prototype the velocity bump logic and GH export.
Zara: Thanks team 9 keep cohorts small, measure velocity, iterate fast. :seedling:
